CI5-XII China reference data for registry comparisons

Source: R/data.R
ci5_xii_china.Rd

A compact reference object built from the China registry records in CI5-XII and CI5-XIId. The asr component is the pooled China incidence reference with one row per sex and CI5-XII cancer category. It contains crude rates and age-standardized rates for the World (1985) and China (2000) standard populations, together with variances on the displayed per-100,000 rate scale. asr_registry keeps the corresponding registry-specific rates for audit and exploratory use.

Usage

ci5_xii_china

Format

A named list with components registry, asr, asr_registry, mv, mi, availability, and metadata.

Source

International Agency for Research on Cancer, Cancer Incidence in Five Continents, Volume XII and Volume XII detailed data. Source files are maintained in the easyCI5 project and are not copied into this package.

Details

CI5-XII/XIId provide incident cases and population at risk only. They do not provide death counts, diagnosis basis, or exact microscopically verified case counts. Consequently, mv and mi are typed empty tables and availability records why those two reference standards are unavailable. They must not be passed to compare_mv() or compare_mi() until an appropriate external source is joined to them.

Examples

data("ci5_xii_china")
head(ci5_xii_china$asr)
#>   cancer sex no_cases       pop        cr       cr_var asr_wld85 asr_var_wld85
